resources.string: Export your ring keys from an installed NOOP app before switching apps. Root access is required. Keep the original app installed until export succeeds.
Key file saved. Import it from Oura → More → Transfer ring keys in the new NOOP app.
The exported XML contains your ring keys in readable form. Store it privately and delete spare copies after importing.
Export failed. Grant this exporter root access and check that the source app is installed for this Android user and still has its original Keystore keys.
Could not save the key file. Try another location.
Export cancelled. No key file was saved.
